text: Steenbarger, on BTSG: no, the trigger carries no volume condition, and my method does not require one. This is a test of the broken pivot, a double stop point (C20): D close_vs_swing_high_pct 0.13, W and D swing_class HH/HL. What answers oneil and minervini on my method is the invalidation, not the volume: a daily close under structure_shift_ref turns the break into a failed test, and C11/C18 say exit fast if it does not move. day_vol 0.51 is a proxy I do not gate on (bar_range_history NOT_SERVED). Adding day_vol above 1 would not change my SUPPORT.
